instrumentation_fix.result: records now show stream = 0x16D9EC (the same stream object seen in all earlier traces)

important_correction: [stream+0x24] is NOT the bit cursor: the ps header writes `last` into it (0x471A58/0x471A69), so after the header it holds the field index, not a bit position
that is why the value reads 0 here while the ps entry trace (taken before the header runs) reads 1308
future probes must use a different cursor source (e.g. [stream+0x1C] byte cursor plus the shift counter) or log deltas rather than absolutes
next: log at 0x6710BB (the call site of the per-field decoder) and at the 0x670FF0 exit to see which branch is taken after the delta is entered
that pinpoints whether the delta returns early (continuation bit 0) or takes the special path (index == -1)
